free_tier.stated: Trial at EUR 0 a month with EUR 5 in starting credits, basic rate limits and community support; the FAQ states 'a card is required at signup to prevent abuse, but nothing is charged', and after the trial an active plan from EUR 25 a month in prepaid credits is required.
free_tier.notes: The EUR 5 credit is one-time and the console lists it as valid for three months. Two first-party pages conflict on the card: the pricing FAQ says 'a card is required at signup to prevent abuse, but nothing is charged', while the console bundle's Trial feature list says 'No credit card required'.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an API request, not a stored object

retention.stated: Unused prepaid credits roll over to the next month and remain valid for 12 months; after cancellation the remaining credits can be used for 30 days.

egress.terms: The Serverless Inference page states 'No egress fees' for the inference API: 'Pay per token, or pick a plan for predictable spend. No egress fees.' The 'Data trafficInbound and outbound, not metered' row belongs to the separate managed Kubernetes Cluster price table.
egress.free_allowance: no egress fees on Serverless Inference, as stated on its own product page

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible inference API at https://api.berget.ai/v1 for chat completions, embeddings and model discovery; the documented call uses a Bearer API key obtained from the console.
tooling: the official OpenAI SDK with base_url set to https://api.berget.ai/v1, or curl against /v1/chat/completions; SDKs are documented for Python and TypeScript
chaining: A drop-in OpenAI endpoint that a coding agent or an existing OpenAI SDK application can point at; the managed Kubernetes cluster adds object storage and unmetered data traffic for pipelines that need it.

limits.value: Basic rate limits on Trial, increased on Starter, higher on Team, maximum on Enterprise; the pricing page states 'Rate limits are shared per account' and publishes no number
EUR 5 in starting credits on Trial, then an active plan from EUR 25 a month in prepaid credits is required for continued API access

binding_note: The EUR 5 starting credit is a one-time amount that is spent by token usage and gates continued access once exhausted; the rate limit is an unpublished qualifier and is not a number that binds first.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing FAQ states 'a card is required at signup to prevent abuse, but nothing is charged'. The console registration submits a name, email and timezone and accepts terms, privacy and DPA; a card intervention is conditional on bot detection. The console bundle's Trial feature list says 'No credit card required', so the two first-party pages conflict. No phone number or ID document is stated.

reliability_note: Rate limits are shared per account and no numeric ceiling is published; unused credits expire 12 months after they are added and 30 days after cancellation.
confidence_note: The plan prices, the starting credit, the card gate and the unmetered cluster traffic are quoted from the vendor's pricing page read on 2026-11-24; the signup fields and the trial credit validity come from the console bundle read the same day.
